title: Ten years up, twenty years down, one morning
lede: Steak and Ale was a public company only from 1971 to 1976, long before EDGAR, and a subsidiary or a private company for the rest of its life. There is no run of annual figures. What follows is every count and dollar amount we could confirm, and the largest gap is the 1980s: no source we read gives a dated count between 1976 and 1989.

blocks.subtitle: Steak and Ale restaurants at the dates a source gives a count. The chain may have been larger in the mid-1980s; see the peak claims below.

points.title: the buyout
points.text: 159 restaurants sold with 221 Bennigan’s for $431M. The highest dated count we found.[^1]

points.title: for sale again
points.text: 66 locations when Metromedia agrees to sell the brand. The sale is not completed.[^23]

blocks.source: Eric N. Berg, The New York Times, March 9, 1989.[^1] The figures are for Steak and Ale and Bennigan’s together; the article does not split them. Derived: $431M ÷ 380 restaurants ≈ $1.13M a restaurant; $716M ÷ 380 ≈ $1.88M of sales a restaurant; $50M ÷ $716M ≈ 7.0%; $431M ÷ $50M ≈ 8.6.

blocks.title: The steakhouse shrank; the tavern did not
blocks.subtitle: Restaurants in each chain in March 1989 and in 2008. The 2008 Bennigan’s figure is domestic restaurants only.
blocks.source: 1989: The New York Times.[^1] 2008: 58 Steak and Ale restaurants in late May, per The Dallas Morning News[^8]; 255 domestic Bennigan’s, of which 159 company-owned and 96 franchised, per the Nation’s Restaurant News Top 100 survey as reported on July 29, 2008, which also put Steak and Ale at “about 55 units.”[^4] The 1989 Bennigan’s figure is not split between company and franchised restaurants.

blocks.title: What was left of the 1989 chain
blocks.subtitle: The 159 Steak and Ale restaurants of March 1989, by whether the chain was still that size in May 2008 (derived).
blocks.source: 159 restaurants in 1989[^1] and 58 in May 2008.[^8] Derived: 58 ÷ 159 ≈ 36%. This compares two totals; we do not know which individual restaurants closed or whether any opened in between.
